domain: Network Graph Representation of Characters from a Fantasy Series
scenario:
A media analytics company is developing an enterprise-level platform to analyze complex relationship networks within popular fantasy series. The platform will focus on mapping and analyzing the intricate web of connections between characters in these series, enabling producers, writers, and marketers to gain insights into character interactions, popularity, and influence within the narrative.

The system will facilitate the creation and management of large network graphs representing character relationships. It will support bidirectional and unidirectional relationships with varying weights to represent the strength or significance of each connection. The platform aims to assist in narrative development, strategy formulation for new content creation, and targeted marketing campaigns based on character dynamics.

Advanced visualization tools will be provided to explore these networks dynamically, allowing users to identify key characters, pivotal relationships, and potential story arcs. Additionally, the system will support historical analysis of character interactions over time, enabling content teams to track character development and changes in relationship significance throughout the series.

The platform will also incorporate user management features to control access levels, ensuring that only authorized personnel can view or edit sensitive narrative data. Reporting tools will be available to provide analytics on network metrics, such as centrality, density, and clustering, supporting data-driven decision-making in media production.
